import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 12;
    static final int INF = 1000000009;
    static final int[] xx = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static final int[] yy = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static final int MAXT = N * 6;  // 72

    static int n, t;
    static char[][] a = new char[N][N];
    static char[][] b = new char[N][N];

    static int sx, sy;
    static int[][] v = new int[N][N];

    static boolean[][][][][] dp = new boolean[MAXT][N][N][N][N];
    static boolean[][][][] u = new boolean[N][N][N][N];

    static int[][] g = new int[2 * N * N + 2][2 * N * N + 2];
    static int[] p = new int[2 * N * N + 2];
    static boolean[] c = new boolean[2 * N * N + 2];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String s = sc.next();
            a[i] = s.toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String s = sc.next();
            b[i] = s.toCharArray();
        }
        sx = sc.nextInt();
        sy = sc.nextInt();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (a[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    sx = i;
                    sy = j;
                }
            }
        }

        bfs(v, sx, sy);

        // DP initialization
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (a[i][j] >= '0' && a[i][j] <= '9') {
                    dp[0][i][j][i][j] = true;
                }
            }
        }

        // DP transitions
        for (int yt = 0; yt < t; yt++) {
            for (int sx2 = 0; sx2 < n; sx2++) {
                for (int sy2 = 0; sy2 < n; sy2++) {
                    for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
                        for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                            if (!dp[yt][sx2][sy2][x][y]) continue;
                            if (v[x][y] <= yt) continue;
                            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                                int hx = x + xx[i];
                                int hy = y + yy[i];
                                if (hx >= 0 && hx < n && hy >= 0 && hy < n && a[hx][hy] >= '0' && a[hx][hy] <= '9') {
                                    if (v[hx][hy] >= yt + 1) {
                                        dp[yt + 1][sx2][sy2][hx][hy] = true;
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Fill u
        for (int yt = 0; yt <= t; yt++) {
            for (int sx2 = 0; sx2 < n; sx2++) {
                for (int sy2 = 0; sy2 < n; sy2++) {
                    for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
                        for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                            if (dp[yt][sx2][sy2][x][y]) {
                                u[sx2][sy2][x][y] = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Build graph
        int nodeCount = 2 * n * n + 2;
        for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(g[i], 0);
        }

        // source to left (a cells)
        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                if (a[x][y] >= '0' && a[x][y] <= '9') {
                    int id = x * n + y + 1;
                    g[0][id] = a[x][y] - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        // right (b cells) to sink
        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                if (b[x][y] >= '0' && b[x][y] <= '9') {
                    int id = n * n + x * n + y + 1;
                    g[id][nodeCount - 1] = b[x][y] - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        // left to right edges if u is true
        for (int x1 = 0; x1 < n; x1++) {
            for (int y1 = 0; y1 < n; y1++) {
                if (!(a[x1][y1] >= '0' && a[x1][y1] <= '9')) continue;
                for (int x2 = 0; x2 < n; x2++) {
                    for (int y2 = 0; y2 < n; y2++) {
                        if (!(a[x2][y2] >= '0' && a[x2][y2] <= '9')) continue;
                        if (!u[x1][y1][x2][y2]) continue;
                        int from = x1 * n + y1 + 1;
                        int to = n * n + x2 * n + y2 + 1;
                        g[from][to] = INF;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Max flow (Edmonds-Karp)
        int totalFlow = 0;
        while (bfs1(nodeCount)) {
            int minCap = INF;
            for (int i = nodeCount - 1; i != 0; i = p[i]) {
                minCap = Math.min(minCap, g[p[i]][i]);
            }
            for (int i = nodeCount - 1; i != 0; i = p[i]) {
                g[p[i]][i] -= minCap;
                g[i][p[i]] += minCap;
            }
            totalFlow += minCap;
        }

        // Compute answer as sum of flow into source (reverse edges)
        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; i++) {
            ans += g[i][0];
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static void bfs(int[][] d, int sx, int sy) {
        boolean[][] visited = new boolean[N][N];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(d[i], INF);
        }
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        visited[sx][sy] = true;
        d[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int hx = x + xx[i];
                int hy = y + yy[i];
                if (hx >= 0 && hx < n && hy >= 0 && hy < n && !visited[hx][hy] && a[hx][hy] >= '0' && a[hx][hy] <= '9') {
                    visited[hx][hy] = true;
                    d[hx][hy] = d[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{hx, hy});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean bfs1(int nodeCount) {
        Arrays.fill(c, false);
        Arrays.fill(p, 0);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        c[0] = true;
        q.add(0);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int x = q.poll();
            if (x == nodeCount - 1) return true;
            for (int h = 0; h < nodeCount; h++) {
                if (g[x][h] > 0) {
                    if (!c[h]) {
                        c[h] = true;
                        p[h] = x;
                        q.add(h);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
}
